name: SVC_MCA_PHONE_MESSAGES
description: This table stores individual messages within a phone call transcript.

columns.name: MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: MESSAGE_NUMBER
columns.description: Public Unique Identifier for an MCA Phone Call Message.

columns.name: CALL_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the SVC_MCA_PHONE_CALLS table.

columns.name: ROLE_CD
columns.description: Lookup Code that indicates the participant's role type.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup Code that indicates the message type.

columns.name: POSTED_BY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID), the Party ID of the person who posted the message. This person can be an internal resource or a customer contact.

columns.name: POSTED_BY_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: The name of the person who posted the message as displayed in the transcript.

columns.name: MESSAGE_CONTENT
columns.description: Textual representation of the phone audio message.

columns.name: VISIBILITY_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates whether the message is INTERNAL, EXTERNAL. Null value is interpreted as EXTERNAL.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
